name: app.R
content:
# Load required libraries library(shiny) library(shinydashboard) library(dplyr) library(tibble) library(tidyr) library(DT) library(plotly) library(scales) # Helper formatting functions rm_fmt <- label_dollar(prefix = "RM ", big.mark = ",") pct_fmt <- label_percent(accuracy = 0.1) # ---- UI ---- ui <- dashboardPage( skin = "blue", dashboardHeader(title = "Investment Mandate Simulator", titleWidth = 350), dashboardSidebar( width = 350, sidebarMenu( menuItem("Current Portfolio Health", tabName = "tab1", icon = icon("heartbeat")), menuItem("Investment Policy Statement", tabName = "tab2", icon = icon("file-contract")), menuItem("Proposed Allocation Simulator", tabName = "tab3", icon = icon("sliders-h")), menuItem("Scenario Testing", tabName = "tab4", icon = icon("chart-line")) ) ), dashboardBody( tabItems( # --- TAB 1: Current Portfolio Health --- tabItem( tabName = "tab1", h2("Mr. Lee's Current Portfolio Analysis"), p("Analyzing the risks of an isolated investing strategy."), fluidRow( valueBoxOutput("curr_wealth_box", width = 4), valueBoxOutput("curr_ret_box", width = 4), valueBoxOutput("curr_vol_box", width = 4) ), fluidRow( box( title = "Current Allocation Overview", status = "primary", solidHeader = TRUE, width = 6, plotlyOutput("curr_pie_chart") ), box( title = "Asset Assumptions", status = "warning", solidHeader = TRUE, width = 6, DTOutput("curr_table") ) ), fluidRow( box( title = "Key Risks Identified", status = "danger", solidHeader = TRUE, width = 12, HTML("
  • Idle Cash Risk: RM2,000,000 is earning 0%, suffering guaranteed loss of purchasing power.
  • Concentration Risk: Heavy reliance on individual 'hot-tip' stocks lacks broad market diversification.
  • Illiquidity Risk: Physical gold and land are difficult to liquidate quickly at fair value during emergencies.
  • Stock Market Crash Risk: A sudden drawdown in individual stocks close to retirement could devastate wealth.
  • Inflation Erosion: The current portfolio struggles to outpace inflation, jeopardizing retirement sustainability.
") ) ) ), # --- TAB 2: Investment Policy Statement Builder --- tabItem( tabName = "tab2", h2("Investment Policy Statement (IPS) Builder"), fluidRow( box( title = "Client Parameters", status = "info", solidHeader = TRUE, width = 4, numericInput("age", "Current Age", value = 55, min = 40, max = 80), numericInput("ret_age", "Retirement Age", value = 60, min = 50, max = 90), numericInput("life_exp", "Life Expectancy", value = 85, min = 70, max = 110), sliderInput("inflation", "Inflation Rate", min = 0, max = 10, value = 3.5, step = 0.1, post = "%"), sliderInput("target_ret", "Target Return", min = 0, max = 15, value = 7.0, step = 0.1, post = "%"), sliderInput("withdrawal_rate", "Post-Retirement Withdrawal Rate", min = 0, max = 10, value = 4.0, step = 0.1, post = "%"), selectInput("risk_tol", "Risk Tolerance", choices = c("Conservative", "Moderate", "Aggressive"), selected = "Conservative") ), box( title = "IPS Summary: Pre & Post Retirement", status = "primary", solidHeader = TRUE, width = 8, DTOutput("ips_table") ) ) ), # --- TAB 3: Proposed Allocation Simulator --- tabItem( tabName = "tab3", h2("Proposed Allocation Simulator"), uiOutput("weight_warning"), fluidRow( # Input Column column(width = 4, box( title = "Adjust Asset Weights (%)", status = "success", solidHeader = TRUE, width = NULL, sliderInput("w_cash", "Cash / Money Market", 0, 100, 5), sliderInput("w_bonds", "Bonds / Sukuk", 0, 100, 35), sliderInput("w_myeq", "Malaysian Dividend Equities", 0, 100, 20), sliderInput("w_gleq", "Global Equities", 0, 100, 15), sliderInput("w_reits", "REITs", 0, 100, 15), sliderInput("w_gold", "Gold / Alternatives", 0, 100, 10) ), box( title = "Adjust Return / Vol Assumptions (%)", status = "primary", solidHeader = TRUE, width = NULL, collapsible = TRUE, collapsed = TRUE, numericInput("r_cash", "Cash Ret", 3.0), numericInput("v_cash", "Cash Vol", 1.0), numericInput("r_bonds", "Bonds Ret", 4.5), numericInput("v_bonds", "Bonds Vol", 5.0), numericInput("r_myeq", "MY Eq Ret", 8.0), numericInput("v_myeq", "MY Eq Vol", 15.0), numericInput("r_gleq", "Global Eq Ret", 8.5), numericInput("v_gleq", "Global Eq Vol", 18.0), numericInput("r_reits", "REITs Ret", 7.0), numericInput("v_reits", "REITs Vol", 14.0), numericInput("r_gold", "Gold Ret", 5.0), numericInput("v_gold", "Gold Vol", 16.0) ) ), # Output Column column(width = 8, fluidRow( valueBoxOutput("prop_ret_box", width = 4), valueBoxOutput("prop_real_box", width = 4), valueBoxOutput("prop_vol_box", width = 4) ), fluidRow( valueBoxOutput("prop_sharpe_box", width = 4), valueBoxOutput("prop_fv_box", width = 4), valueBoxOutput("prop_withdraw_box", width = 4) ), fluidRow( box(title = "Status Indicators", status = "info", solidHeader = TRUE, width = 12, h4(textOutput("status_ret")), h4(textOutput("status_risk")) ) ), fluidRow( box(title = "Proposed Portfolio Breakdown", status = "primary", solidHeader = TRUE, width = 12, plotlyOutput("prop_pie_chart") ) ) ) ) ), # --- TAB 4: Scenario Testing & Rebalancing --- tabItem( tabName = "tab4", h2("Scenario Testing & Rebalancing Strategy"), p("Evaluating portfolio resilience under Best, Base, and Worst market scenarios over 1 year."), fluidRow( box( title = "1-Year Scenario Projections", status = "primary", solidHeader = TRUE, width = 12, plotlyOutput("scenario_chart") ) ), fluidRow( box( title = "Scenario Data", status = "info", solidHeader = TRUE, width = 12, DTOutput("scenario_table") ) ), fluidRow( box( title = "Rebalancing Rules & Whitman Logic", status = "success", solidHeader = TRUE, width = 12, p("The current allocation carries idle cash, concentration risk, and illiquidity. The proposed allocation improves diversification and aims for more stable total wealth growth. The goal is not to choose the single best-performing asset, but to improve total portfolio outcome with controlled downside."), hr(), DTOutput("rebalance_table") ) ) ) ) ) ) # ---- SERVER ---- server <- function(input, output, session) { # Constants initial_wealth <- 5000000 rf_rate <- 0.035 # --- TAB 1 Logics --- curr_data <- tibble( Asset = c("Cash / Current Account", "Hot-tip Stocks", "Physical Gold & Land"), Amount = c(2000000, 1500000, 1500000), Exp_Return = c(0.00, 0.08, 0.05), Volatility = c(0.01, 0.25, 0.18) ) %>% mutate(Weight = Amount / sum(Amount)) curr_w_ret <- sum(curr_data$Weight * curr_data$Exp_Return) curr_w_vol <- sum(curr_data$Weight * curr_data$Volatility) # Simple approximation output$curr_wealth_box <- renderValueBox({ valueBox(rm_fmt(initial_wealth), "Total Wealth", icon = icon("wallet"), color = "navy") }) output$curr_ret_box <- renderValueBox({ valueBox(pct_fmt(curr_w_ret), "Exp. Nominal Return", icon = icon("arrow-up"), color = "red") }) output$curr_vol_box <- renderValueBox({ valueBox(pct_fmt(curr_w_vol), "Est. Volatility (Risk)", icon = icon("exclamation-triangle"), color = "orange") }) output$curr_table <- renderDT({ curr_data %>% mutate(Amount = rm_fmt(Amount), Weight = pct_fmt(Weight), Exp_Return = pct_fmt(Exp_Return), Volatility = pct_fmt(Volatility)) %>% datatable(options = list(dom = 't', paging = FALSE)) }) output$curr_pie_chart <- renderPlotly({ plot_ly(curr_data, labels = ~Asset, values = ~Amount, type = 'pie', textinfo = 'label+percent', marker = list(colors = c("#a6cee3", "#1f78b4", "#b2df8a"))) %>% layout(showlegend = TRUE) }) # --- TAB 2 Logics --- output$ips_table <- renderDT({ ips_df <- tibble( Category = c("Objective", "Time Horizon", "Risk Tolerance", "Return Requirement", "Liquidity Need", "Main Risks", "Suitable Style"), `Pre-Retirement` = c( "Grow wealth cautiously before retirement", paste0(input$ret_age - input$age, " years"), "Low to moderate", "7% nominal target", "Medium", "Market crash before retirement, inflation, poor diversification", "Diversified growth with downside protection" ), `Post-Retirement` = c( "Preserve capital and generate income", paste0(input$life_exp - input$ret_age, " years"), "Low", "Inflation-beating income and sustainable withdrawals", "High", "Longevity risk, inflation risk, sequence-of-return risk", "Income generation and capital preservation" ) ) datatable(ips_df, options = list(dom = 't', paging = FALSE), rownames = FALSE) }) # --- TAB 3 Logics --- prop_weights <- reactive({ w_raw <- c(input$w_cash, input$w_bonds, input$w_myeq, input$w_gleq, input$w_reits, input$w_gold) total_w <- sum(w_raw) # Normalize if not 0 if(total_w == 0) { w_norm <- rep(0, 6) } else { w_norm <- w_raw / total_w } list(raw = total_w, norm = w_norm) }) output$weight_warning <- renderUI({ req(prop_weights()) total <- prop_weights()$raw if (total != 100) { div(class = "alert alert-warning", paste0("Warning: Weights sum to ", total, "%. Allocations have been automatically normalized to 100% for calculations.")) } else { div(class = "alert alert-success", "Weights correctly sum to 100%.") } }) prop_calc <- reactive({ w <- prop_weights()$norm rets <- c(input$r_cash, input$r_bonds, input$r_myeq, input$r_gleq, input$r_reits, input$r_gold) / 100 vols <- c(input$v_cash, input$v_bonds, input$v_myeq, input$v_gleq, input$v_reits, input$v_gold) / 100 w_ret <- sum(w * rets) w_vol <- sum(w * vols) # Weighted average proxy infl <- input$inflation / 100 r_ret <- ((1 + w_ret) / (1 + infl)) - 1 sharpe <- ifelse(w_vol == 0, 0, (w_ret - rf_rate) / w_vol) yrs_to_retire <- max(0, input$ret_age - input$age) fv <- initial_wealth * (1 + w_ret)^yrs_to_retire withdrawal <- fv * (input$withdrawal_rate / 100) list(w_ret = w_ret, r_ret = r_ret, w_vol = w_vol, sharpe = sharpe, fv = fv, withdrawal = withdrawal) }) output$prop_ret_box <- renderValueBox({ valueBox(pct_fmt(prop_calc()$w_ret), "Exp. Nominal Return", icon = icon("chart-bar"), color = "green") }) output$prop_real_box <- renderValueBox({ valueBox(pct_fmt(prop_calc()$r_ret), "Real Return (Adj. Inflation)", icon = icon("percentage"), color = "teal") }) output$prop_vol_box <- renderValueBox({ valueBox(pct_fmt(prop_calc()$w_vol), "Est. Volatility", icon = icon("tachometer-alt"), color = "light-blue") }) output$prop_sharpe_box <- renderValueBox({ valueBox(round(prop_calc()$sharpe, 2), "Est. Sharpe Ratio", icon = icon("balance-scale"), color = "purple") }) output$prop_fv_box <- renderValueBox({ valueBox(rm_fmt(prop_calc()$fv), "Projected Wealth at Retirement", icon = icon("piggy-bank"), color = "green") }) output$prop_withdraw_box <- renderValueBox({ valueBox(rm_fmt(prop_calc()$withdrawal), "Sustainable Annual Withdrawal", icon = icon("hand-holding-usd"), color = "olive") }) output$status_ret <- renderText({ if(prop_calc()$w_ret >= (input$target_ret/100)) "✅ Target return achieved (>= 7%)" else "❌ Below target return (< 7%)" }) output$status_risk <- renderText({ if(prop_calc()$w_vol <= 0.10) "✅ Risk within conservative range (<= 10%)" else "⚠️ Risk may exceed conservative tolerance (> 10%)" }) output$prop_pie_chart <- renderPlotly({ w <- prop_weights()$norm labels <- c("Cash / Money Market", "Bonds / Sukuk", "Malaysian Eq", "Global Eq", "REITs", "Gold / Alts") df <- data.frame(labels, w) %>% filter(w > 0) plot_ly(df, labels = ~labels, values = ~w, type = 'pie', textinfo = 'label+percent') %>% layout(showlegend = TRUE) }) # --- TAB 4 Logics --- scenario_data <- reactive({ w <- prop_weights()$norm # Scenario Returns by asset # Assets: Cash, Bonds, MYEq, GlobEq, REITs, Gold best_rets <- c(0.03, 0.06, 0.14, 0.15, 0.10, 0.06) base_rets <- c(0.03, 0.045, 0.08, 0.085, 0.07, 0.05) worst_rets <- c(0.03, 0.03, -0.25, -0.28, -0.15, 0.08) # Current portfolio approx: Cash 40%, Stocks(MYEq) 30%, Gold 30% curr_w <- c(0.40, 0, 0.30, 0, 0, 0.30) curr_ret_best <- sum(curr_w * best_rets) curr_ret_base <- sum(curr_w * base_rets) curr_ret_worst <- sum(curr_w * worst_rets) prop_ret_best <- sum(w * best_rets) prop_ret_base <- sum(w * base_rets) prop_ret_worst <- sum(w * worst_rets) df <- tibble( Scenario = c("Best Case", "Base Case", "Worst Case"), `Current Portfolio Return` = c(curr_ret_best, curr_ret_base, curr_ret_worst), `Current Portfolio Value` = initial_wealth * (1 + c(curr_ret_best, curr_ret_base, curr_ret_worst)), `Proposed Portfolio Return` = c(prop_ret_best, prop_ret_base, prop_ret_worst), `Proposed Portfolio Value` = initial_wealth * (1 + c(prop_ret_best, prop_ret_base, prop_ret_worst)) ) %>% mutate(Difference = `Proposed Portfolio Value` - `Current Portfolio Value`) df }) output$scenario_table <- renderDT({ scenario_data() %>% mutate( `Current Portfolio Return` = pct_fmt(`Current Portfolio Return`), `Proposed Portfolio Return` = pct_fmt(`Proposed Portfolio Return`), `Current Portfolio Value` = rm_fmt(`Current Portfolio Value`), `Proposed Portfolio Value` = rm_fmt(`Proposed Portfolio Value`), Difference = rm_fmt(Difference) ) %>% datatable(options = list(dom = 't', paging = FALSE), rownames = FALSE) %>% formatStyle('Difference', color = styleInterval(0, c('red', 'green'))) }) output$scenario_chart <- renderPlotly({ df <- scenario_data() %>% select(Scenario, `Current Portfolio Value`, `Proposed Portfolio Value`) %>% pivot_longer(cols = -Scenario, names_to = "Portfolio", values_to = "Value") plot_ly(df, x = ~Scenario, y = ~Value, color = ~Portfolio, type = 'bar', barmode = 'group', colors = c("#e41a1c", "#377eb8")) %>% layout(yaxis = list(title = "Wealth after 1 Year (RM)"), xaxis = list(categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = c("Worst Case", "Base Case", "Best Case"))) }) output$rebalance_table <- renderDT({ rebal_df <- tibble( `Asset Class` = c("Cash / Money Market", "Bonds / Sukuk", "Malaysian Dividend Equities", "Global Equities", "REITs", "Gold / Alternatives"), `Target Allocation` = c("5%", "35%", "20%", "15%", "15%", "10%"), `Allowable Range` = c("5–10%", "30–45%", "15–25%", "10–20%", "10–20%", "5–15%"), `Action if market stress occurs` = c( "Maintain liquidity buffer", "Increase if market volatility rises", "Reduce if downside risk exceeds tolerance", "Reduce under severe equity drawdown", "Maintain for income unless rates rise sharply", "Increase during crisis hedge scenario" ) ) datatable(rebal_df, options = list(dom = 't', paging = FALSE), rownames = FALSE) }) } shinyApp(ui, server)
